subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Schrock's first alkylidene（Ta(CH₂t-Bu)₃(=CHt-Bu)）？
A. Tetrahedral
B. Square planar
C. Square pyramidal
D. Trigonal bipyramidal
explanation: Tetrahedral. Covalent count: Ta (group 5) 5 e; 1 × =CHt-Bu (X₂) 2 e; 3 × CH₂t-Bu (X) 3 e: 10 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −5 in all and the complex is neutral, so the metal is Ta(V), d⁰; d⁰ + 10 e from the ligands = 10 e. A Schrock alkylidene is an X2 ligand: Ta(V), d⁰.
